req.title: Redirect to arbitrary URL
req.statement: The system shall issue an HTTP 302 redirect to the URL given by the 'url' query parameter of /redirect-to.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should issue an HTTP 302 redirect to a URL provided by the 'url' query parameter. This behavior needs to be verified through positive, negative, and boundary test cases to ensure robustness against common mutations and edge cases.

tests.name: test_redirect_to_valid_url
preconditions: The server is running and accessible.
actions: Send a GET request to /redirect-to with a valid URL as the query parameter.
expected: The Location header matches the provided URL.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.get('/redirect-to?url=https://example.com')
assert response.status_code == 302
assert response.headers['Location'] == b'https://example.com'

tests.name: test_redirect_to_missing_url
preconditions: The server is running and accessible.
actions: Send a GET request to /redirect-to without a URL query parameter.
expected: The response status code is 400 or another client error code.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.get('/redirect-to')
assert response.status_code == 400

tests.name: test_redirect_to_empty_url
preconditions: The server is running and accessible.
actions: Send a GET request to /redirect-to with an empty URL as the query parameter.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.get('/redirect-to?url=')
assert response.status_code == 302
assert response.headers['Location'] == b''
